Not even thank you or sorry. Watching expert videos daily, practicing chat with Isha Mam, solving doubts, correcting mistakes by speaking to each other. Slowly mother also started learning, son also started learning. 3 months.] Speaker A: How was your day, beta? Speaker B: It was good, ma. I had fun today. Thank you for asking. Speaker A: पहले थैंक यू भी नहीं बोल पाया था, आज थैंक यू फॉर आस्किंग बोलता है। हम दोनों ने साथ सीखा। ₹1 का ट्रायल आज। [Earlier he couldn't even say thank you, today he says thank you for asking.
